description: The identities with no authored secondary-condition mappings at all, ranked by recorded demand as a secondary condition against the inbound coverage they already have. 'requestedAsSecondary' counts authored CRG request rows under docs/ that name the identity as the secondary; 'inboundEdges' counts authored relationships in data/knowledge-base that already name it as a secondary. gapScore = (1 + requestedAsSecondary) / (1 + inboundEdges).
